I enjoyed it a lot, now that we're discussing. I totaly didn't think of the fact those were Haka's that he was doing!

 

I do agree that the songs weren't quite as memorable as some previous disney movies. And given that it wasn't really a Villain does bad things we have to stop them story, but rather a 'This is a story of finding out who you really are,' it feels... well just different than most disney movies. 

 

I haven't seen Kubo and the Two STrings yet Rabbit, but I really really want to.
